sonnet.problem: The card says Jeremiah is the one speaking in verse 15 ("Now he opens with..."). The passage text and its heading don't name the speaker of verses 15-19. Stop 2 correctly uses the neutral "the message", so the stops are also inconsistent.
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.

sonnet.problem: The card attributes the "I will weep in secret" line (verse 17) to Jeremiah, and card 7 does the same with the tears. The passage never names who says "I" here.
sonnet.rule: When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first... When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.
